components.description: Empty, no-results or offline state. Size = S (inside a card) | M (page section) | L (full screen) = 3 variants. Mascot (2.3, exposed; default Pose = sleepy for empty states, dizzy for errors/offline, success for completion; size S→M 64, M→L 96, L→2XL 200), Title, Description and up to two Buttons (exposed; Primary = Action, Secondary = Outline). Text max width follows the variant width; keep copy
